159869.overview: A mixture of text adventuring and arcade action, Island of Death puts you in the shoes of the sole survivor of a shipwreck on a coral reef. In order to escape you need to find the six treasures of the island. Dangerous encounters come in the form of simple arcade games.

175616.overview: Ice Giant is a side-scrolling shoot 'em up similar to The Empire Strikes Back and The Attack of the Mutant Camels. A wizard has sent a number of magical ice giants to destroy the player's fortress. Mounted on a winged battle beast, the player has to prevent them from doing that by simply shooting them until they die. The giants, who appear in waves of five, slowly walk towards the fortress and if they manage to reach it the game ends. The player can also die by getting hit by the magical snowballs that the giants throw. After completing the first few waves, magical snow that kills the player on contact will start falling.

175856.overview: You must defend the earth from hordes of bomb dropping space invaders, using your earth bound laser base. The more invaders you hit, the faster they come, leading to a gun-blazing shootout finale.

175919.overview:
Intox et Zoé is an adaptation of educational French TV show series Tify ...s'il te plaît, raconte-moi une puce run on TF1 in 1984, which are dedicated to the strange machines called "microcomputers" appearing all around the world at that time. Main characters of this show, Intox and Zoé, are protagonists of the game.

The game is divided in two parts. During the first part, the virtual city is auto-generated and always different for each game launch. Intox and Zoé find themselves in this city, and the player should find the exit by moving them from one screen of the city streets to another. When arriving at crossroads, a question related to microcomputing is asked, and a correct answer proposes a direction to follow.

459626.overview:
Invaders is a Space Invaders clone for multiple systems.

The player controls a ship that moves laterally at the bottom of the screen and fires vertically. Four large bases provide protection from enemy fire, but also block the player's shots. These get damaged when shot. Enemies move as a group laterally across the screen until they reach the edge, move down one row, and reverse direction. Enemies return fire at the player, and the player must destroy all enemies before they reach the bottom of the screen. Enemy speed increases as more invaders are removed from the group. UFOs move across the top of the screen which can be destroyed for bonus points.

476521.overview:
An all machine code version of the classic arcade game for your Oric 1.
Features: Super Fast, Smooth action laser base, Full Colour, 1 or 2 player options, Authentic Aliens, Mother Ships, Switchable Sound, Hi-Score Table, Game Reset.

Another exciting arcade game for your Oric 1 from PSS.
